description: Search the tools on this server by task or keyword in plain words. Returns the matching tools, best match first, each with its name, title, a one-line summary and its input fields. With no words it lists every tool on this server. Use it when you are not sure which tool here fits a task.

keyword.description: Optional: one keyword. Searched together with query and task.

query.description: Optional words or a task to search for, such as "vat number". Omit query, task and keyword to list every tool.

task.description: Optional: the task in plain words. Searched together with query and keyword.

name: index_tools

hint.description: What to do next when no tool matched.

query.description: The search words, when any were given.

inputs.description: The tool's input fields; required ones end with *.

name.description: Tool name to call on this server.

summary.description: The first sentence of the tool's description.

title.description: What the tool does, in plain words.

title: Search the tools on this server
